Hosted by Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-naguricanoe-canoesyokyu-akihuyu/

Canadian canoeing uses a single-blade paddle to glide smoothly across the water in an active, dynamic way. Learn steering techniques and paddling skills while enjoying the experience of controlling your canoe.

【Fee】¥3,000 per person (includes guide, insurance, and canoe rental)

【Capacity】5 people

【Guide】Staff from the certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop

【What to bring】Drinking water (vending machines available at the workshop), and as needed: hat, sunglasses, or other sun protection

【Notes】For more information, visit the certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop website: https://naguri-canoe.co.jp/
location: 集合 名栗カヌー工房（国際興業バス「ノーラ名栗・さわらびの湯」下車徒歩20分、または「河又名栗湖入口」下車25分）
